note: Class-scoped and tree-only. crossClass = a `this.<f>.<m>` read inside class C where exactly one OTHER class D writes `this.<f> = new T()`. The analyzer keys fieldTypes by FIELD NAME alone (collectLocalReceiverTypes), so C's read is published with owner=T — a class C has no relationship with. If T declares `m`, the store's owner pass binds C's edge to T.m.
